name: Generate a generic REST API source from OpenAPI

checks.check: The closure follows the provided OpenAPI contract for the server, GET /orders route, results envelope, cursor and bearer scheme, and honors its x-nexty-required-scopes authorization extension for orders:read rather than inventing another API.
Ingestion uses dlt RESTAPIConfig/rest_api_resources; it does not hand-roll HTTP or use a client library beside the connector.

The single orders resource flows unchanged to one replace-mode dlt run through the typed Desktop DuckDB output port; the transform compares actual tables with duckdb.model_tables for PHYSICAL_MODELS and touches .transform-complete only after the read-back check succeeds. The no-renaming shortcut is specific to this one-model fixture, not a general Desktop recipe.
The orders resource selects results and explicitly follows next_cursor using the after query parameter.

The API endpoint topology, bearer auth and exact required_scopes metadata are driven by flat api-source profile attributes; the bearer-required contract rejects missing or unsupported auth_type, auth_token is private, and the transform passes that secret into dlt's structured bearer auth.

The generated resource remains read-only and contains no credential literal. The private profile placeholder is clearly non-usable; the standalone connectivity probe accepts a runtime credential only from ORDERS_READ_TOKEN, refuses missing/placeholder values, never prints or logs the credential, and passes it to any helper only by an explicit token= keyword.

The agent does not claim to have run dlt, materialized the product, executed the connectivity probe, or contacted an API; README explicitly marks both payload inspection and connectivity as not run and unverified.
